name: osmo
description: OsmO's AI makes real phone calls for you: call a business or helpline, then get the summary and transcript. Every call is confirmed by you first. Sign in with your phone number; no API key. 50 free credits for new users in the US, Canada, UK and Australia: with free credits, OsmO calls businesses and toll-free numbers; calling your contacts and scheduling calls need an OsmO app plan.

interface.shortDescription: Real phone calls made for you
interface.longDescription: OsmO's voice AI places real phone calls for you to a shop, clinic, restaurant, helpline or toll-free number. It asks what you need, gets through phone menus, and brings back the outcome, a summary and the transcript. Nothing is dialled until you confirm who will be called and what will be said. It connects to the hosted OsmO MCP server at api.getosmo.app; you sign in once in the browser with your phone number and a one-time code, with no API key. New users in the US, Canada, the UK and Australia get 50 free credits (an answered call uses 3; unanswered calls are free). With free credits, OsmO calls businesses and toll-free numbers; calling your contacts and scheduling calls need an OsmO app plan. With an OsmO app plan it can also tell you who called your OsmO number and change your call-screening rules. Not for emergency services, text messages or email.
